svg.aria-label: Cairn, a document-grounded RAG platform in active development. Organize documents into workspaces and projects, ask questions over any slice of them, and get answers where every claim traces back to a source page or line range. The same documents also generate quizzes, flashcards, charts, and diagrams. Built with Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker, Nginx, Prometheus, Grafana, Gemini, SQLAlchemy, and Pydantic. An example answer with two numbered citations is shown.
